data.command: select vd.VrstaDokId,vd.Opis,vd.Prefix,vp.Sifra from VrstaDok vd,VrstaProm vp where vd.VrstaPromId in (select VrstaPromId from VrstaProm where Projekt = 'K') And vd.VrstaPromId = vp.VrstaPromId order by vd.opis
data.name: dtVrstaDok

data.command: select p.KntPlanAId,p.PartneriId,p.Opis,k.Konto as Konto,k.Konto as BrojKonta,k.Naziv as Naziv, OrgShemaId ,(select Naziv from partneri where partneriid=(select partneriid from KntPromet where KntPrometId={$ZadnjiKntPrometId})) as PartnerNaziv, p.DatumDokumenta from KntPromet p inner join KntPlanA k on p.KntPlanAId=k.kntplanaid where KntPrometId={$ZadnjiKntPrometId}
data.name: dtZadnjaStavka

data.command: select top 1 KntPrometId from KntPromet where KntTemId={global.$KntTemId} order by KntPrometId desc
data.name: dtZadnjiKntPromet
dtCalcIznosObicni
data.command: select round(@IznosDug*@tecaj,2) as IznosKNDug, round(@IznosPot*@tecaj,2) as IznosKNPot
